in_marathi.name: Maitreya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of all, the wise one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maitreya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maitreya is the name of an ancient Buddhist sage who is believed to be the future Buddha. The term ‘Maitreya’ comes from the Sanskrit word ‘maitra,’ which means friend or loving. In Hindu and Buddhist mythology, Maitreya is considered to be the embodiment of compassion and wisdom.
